summary: Dependency-confusion package exfiltrates CI/CD and cloud credentials via preinstall native binary
details: @galicia-toolkit-nestjs/swagger@999.0.3 is a dependency-confusion/typosquat lure targeting @nestjs/swagger. package.json declares scripts.preinstall='node index.js || true', which require()s an opaque prebuilt native addon at prebuilds/<platform>-<arch>/metrics.node. The native binary reads a hardcoded list of credential-grade environment variables from the installer (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, NODE_AUTH_TOKEN, SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN, ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN, ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN, AZURE_DEVOPS_EXT_PAT), together with hostname, username, and cwd, and sends them via a hand-crafted raw-socket 'POST /native HTTP/1.0' request to oob.s4yhii.com, bypassing Node's HTTP stack. The JS entrypoint exports stub forRoot/createLogger to impersonate a @nestjs/swagger-shaped module, and the payload is labeled 'metrics'/'_METRICS_PKG' as cover. Fires automatically on npm install with full user privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
